# AI Resume Tailor

> AI Resume Tailor tailors an existing resume to a specific job posting and reports an ATS keyword-match score. It is free to try with no login required, the first 3 tailored resumes are free, and paid access is a one-time purchase — there is no subscription and nothing auto-renews.

AI Resume Tailor does one job: it rewrites a candidate's existing resume so it matches the wording of one specific job posting, while keeping the resume recognisably theirs. You paste a resume and a job description and get back a tailored version, a keyword-match score, the keywords that are missing, and a plain-English explanation of what changed and why. It is not a resume builder and it does not replace the resume with a template — it works from the document the candidate already has.

The site also provides a free ATS resume checker that reports compatibility, formatting and header problems, missing-keyword signals, and action-verb strength.

## Pricing and free tier

- **Free to try, no login required.** A first preview needs no account: paste a resume and a job description and get the score and the missing-keyword list.
- **First 3 tailored resumes free**, including viewing and downloading them as PDF or Markdown, with no credit card required.
- **Paid access is a one-time purchase**, not a subscription: 2 days $9.00, 1 week $19.00, 1 month $29.00 (USD). Nothing auto-renews and there is nothing to cancel.

## How it works

A multi-step pipeline profiles the resume, analyses the job posting and its key requirements, plans which bullets to change, rewrites those bullets, then reassembles and scores the result. Before rewriting, the tool asks the candidate a small number of optional plain-English questions about specifics their resume left out (scale, outcomes, size) — the candidate's own answers are the only source of any new figure, and every question can be skipped.

## Honesty constraints

- It does **not** invent metrics, percentages, headcounts or outcomes, and it does not inflate scope. A rewrite that fails the authenticity check is dropped and the original wording is kept, so the output cannot contain an achievement the source resume does not support.
- It works from the candidate's own text. Where a supplied fact does not fit a bullet, it is omitted rather than replaced with an invented number.
- It does **not** claim to replicate or reverse-engineer any specific ATS vendor's algorithm, and it does not guarantee interviews, callbacks or outcomes.
- A keyword-match score measures overlap with one job posting. It is a filter to clear, not a pass mark or a promise.
- Competitor comparisons on this site state our own price from a single source of truth and cite the competitor figures used; where a competitor's price could not be sourced, no figure is stated.

- [Pricing](https://airesumetailor.com/pricing): One-time access tiers (2-day, 1-week, 1-month). The first 3 tailored resumes are free; no subscription.

- [Blog](https://airesumetailor.com/blog): Guides on resume tailoring, ATS compatibility, and role-specific keywords.
